Symbol names often descriptions not atomic words: MOON=𗿃𗇾; WAVE=𗡒𗏻 [relative clause] 𗡒𘜇 predicate 𗌿𗐪 𗡒𗪺 ('symbol whose shape resembles water', wording tentative); SUN=𗡒𗏻 𗡒𗸽 𘆣𘋉, also more complex description in 9; STAR=𗡒𗏻 [relative] 𗡒𘜇 predicate 𗡒𗸽 𘆣𘇩 𘆣𗽃. Beware #8 malformed single glyph 𗜑 interrupting this SUN-like description: do not force-clean it.

Structural correction/strong evidence: 𘅌𗐪 is clause OPEN, not assertion; 𘅌𘝚 is PREDICATE marker. Message 4 puts SUBJECT first: OPEN SUBJECT(symbol light day) PRED(be) OBJECT(digit base 2) CLOSE, unlike usual OPEN PRED SUBJECT OBJECT CLOSE. Thus explicit role markers allow flexible order. 𘅌𗜑 marks embedded description/clause. Please investigate 𘅌𗌸 (before numbers and other supplements), 𘅌𗸽 (often before success/current), 𘅌𘋟 (to/addressee), and 𘅌𗤴 (comparison/temporal before). I will assemble draft after independent analyses arrive.

Compositional hypothesis for symbol descriptions (medium/low, not forced): 𗡒𗏻=symbol/sign, 𗡒𗸽=light, 𘆣𘋉=yellow. SUN literal 'symbol light yellow'; STAR relative description uses 𗡒𗸽 𘆣𘇩 𘆣𗽃='light small distant' (small/distant low). WAVE relative uses 𗌿𗐪 𗡒𗪺='moving water' (medium); shared relative predicate 𗡒𘜇 may be depict/represent rather than 'shape'. #9 SUN relative object 𗌿𗹫 𘆣𘋉 could be 'round yellow', followed nested 𗌿𗻲 ... light = emitting light. This better explains why light is in SUN and STAR while water+motion WAVE. Recommend retaining literal compounds and marking individual root guesses instead of treating descriptors as atomic symbol names.

Additional compositional insight: #31 appears to define the literal/control name DRAIN 𗿃𗏶 via nested `𗌿𗳃 [object] 𗡒𗪺`, plausibly 'remove/drain water'. This supports 𗡒𗪺=water, 𗌿𗳃=remove/drain (medium), and WAVE's shape descriptor `𗌿𗐪 𗡒𗪺` plausibly 'moving water'. #27 SIGNAL prerequisite actually embeds the same remove-water clause, rather than atomic DRAIN; preserve paraphrase. #26 directly supports 𗌿𗚋=consume/cost, 𗡒𘅊=charge/energy, 𗡒𗚽=signal. #9 and #86 SUN description has shape `𗌿𗹫 𘆣𘋉`, plus nested predicate `𗌿𗻲 [object] 𗡒𗸽`: likely round/circular shape and emits light. Thus 𗡒𗸽 plausibly light, 𗌿𗻲 emit/show (medium/low), not a generic SUN word. #4 simpler SUN expression is 'symbol light round' (exact adjective unknown).
